chunks: And about a man: is it proper for him to perform salat while a lamp is placed before him in the direction of the qiblah? He said: “It is not proper for him to face the fire.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray while facing a lamp or fire in the direction of the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat and the positioning of a lamp or flame in front of the worshipper toward the qiblah. The Imam عليه السلام states that it is not proper to face fire during prayer, indicating a disliked or impermissible prayer posture in this context.
